rationale: Pivot from knn_classifier (16 sweeps, plateaued at best 3/7 #770 +47.9% ann, last 4 iters 1-2/7) to qda_classifier — first generative classifier in registry. Default reg_param=0.6 pca=16 already passes W6 cleanly (40.9% WR / 13.8% DD); the 105-config search space (reg_param ∈ 7 values × pca ∈ 5 × tol ∈ 3) is untouched. The genuinely different inductive bias (class-conditional Gaussian densities → Bayes posterior) is the next experiment after knn's distance-weighted heuristic plateaued.
